facts_of_case: Petitioner was married to respondent in 1990. Respondent filed divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, which was allowed on August 5, 2003. Petitioner filed appeal and this court issued notice to show cause on September 19, 2003. Interim order was passed restraining respondent from remarrying.

legal_principles.principle: The time for appeal under Section 15 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, is to be taken from the date of decree and not from the date of filing the appeal.
legal_principles.held: This court holds that the period of 30 days is to be counted from the date of decree or order and not by giving benefit of period spent in obtaining the certified copy.

legal_principles.principle: A party to a marriage cannot remarry until the appeal period has expired or an appeal has been presented and dismissed.
legal_principles.held: It shall be lawful for either party to the marriage to marry again when a marriage has been dissolved by a decree of divorce and either there is no right of appeal against the decree or, if there is such a right of appeal, the time for appealing has expired without any appeal having been presented, or an appeal has been presented but has been dismissed.

outcome.final_order: Court restrained respondent from remarrying and ordered him to be present in court on next date.
